name: Floating Island of Musical Stones
description: An island drifting in a pastel sky, its surface covered in stones that emit pure tones when touched.
prompt: A lone island floating among soft pastel clouds at sunrise. The ground is a mosaic of smooth stones in varied sizes, each glowing faintly. When a bare foot steps on a stone, a visible ripple of light and a musical note emanate. Ethereal, magical realism, high resolution, serene palette.
caption: Step lightly, the earth sings 🎶☁️ #MusicalIsland
